conviction_note: The P&L is new on this print and the loan book is only two-thirds pre-released, so abs_move is 6.0, a little under the 7% European base because July and August loans are already out. p_up is 58: consensus EPS of 3.27 implies only about +10% QoQ, while Q2-to-Q3 operating profit rose 21% (2024) and 18% (2025) in the company's own releases, and consensus under-called the loan book in Q1 and Q2 2026. This is an inference that sell-side may already model, and a tight total-capital buffer offsets part of it. The findings sum (+1.6) and the scaled number (+0.96) agree in sign and differ in size because p_up carries the doubt and the findings do not.

findings.finding: Q3 is this company's seasonally strong quarter: operating profit rose from Q2 to Q3 by 21% in 2024 (157.7 to 191.3 MSEK) and 18% in 2025 (195.1 to 230.9 MSEK), but the 3.27 consensus EPS implies only about +10% QoQ on Q2 2026's 2.97 (operating profit about 280 against 255.9). The same seasonality would give about 300-310 MSEK, roughly a 7-10% beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Observed results-day closes: Q1 2026 operating profit a slight miss (244.6 against 248) gave +0.7%; Q2 2026 in line (255.9 against 256) gave +11.6% on the loan beat; Q3 2025 -6.7%; Q4 2025 +4.0%; Q3 2024 +9.8%. The stock reacts more to the growth line than to EPS.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar itself (3.27, about +10% QoQ) is the evidence. If the market expected the seasonal step-up, consensus would sit near 3.5. Four analysts cover the stock, turnover is about $1m a day, and the stock is down 6% over 20 days into the print rather than running up.
findings.independence: The Q2/Q3 2024 figures come from separate releases: https://mfn.se/cis/a/tf-bank/tf-bank-ab-publ-interim-report-january-june-2024-6745f2fd and https://mfn.se/cis/a/tf-bank/tf-bank-ab-publ-interim-report-january-september-2024-cd7a5927. Q2 2026 is from https://mb.cision.com/Main/13973/4373343/4189231.pdf. All are company documents and all make the same seasonal argument.

findings.finding: The September-end loan book (the one Q3 loan figure not yet published) should land around SEK 28.2-28.4bn, about +7-8% QoQ in SEK. The drivers are the August base of 27,407 MSEK, organic growth running about 1-2.5% a month, and a September FX tailwind (EURSEK 11.12 to 11.34, NOKSEK 1.025 to 1.039) on a mostly euro/Nordic book. Consensus under-called the loan book in Q1 2026 (24.1bn expected against 24.55 actual) and Q2 2026 (25.5 against 26.3), and the Q2 beat on this line coincided with +11.6% on the day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: loans 26.3bn against 25.5bn consensus with EPS in line, stock +11.6%. Q1 2026: loans 24.55 against 24.1 consensus, operating profit slight miss, +0.7%.
findings.original_quote: Totala låneportföljen uppgick vid utgången av augusti månad 2026 till 27 407 MSEK. Jämfört med augusti 2025 har låneportföljen ökat med 21 % i lokala valutor. (The total loan portfolio amounted to SEK 27,407m at the end of August 2026; compared with August 2025 it has increased by 21% in local currencies.)
findings.why_not_priced: July and August are public, so this finding is worth only the September increment plus the translation effect of the late-September SEK weakness, which a model updated off the August statistics would miss. SB1 raised its estimates on 8 October 'främst tack vare en större låneportfölj' (mainly because of a larger loan portfolio), which shows at least one model is still catching up. Consensus has missed low on this line two quarters running.
findings.independence: FX series: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/EURSEK=X?range=6mo&interval=1d. Q1 consensus-versus-actual: https://www.affarsvarlden.se/aktierekar/infor-delarsrapport-analytiker-trygga-i-lanetillvaxten-for-avarda-bank-r (snippet only; affarsvarlden is unreachable). Partly shares its growth driver with finding 1, but the evidence is different: balance sheet here, P&L seasonality there.

findings.finding: The total capital headroom is thin and probably shrank in Q3. Q2 total capital was 15.7% against a 12.9% requirement (2.8pp against the 2.5pp target), on own funds of SEK 3,504m and REA of 22,270m. About 7-8% REA growth (organic plus a weaker SEK) against about 110 MSEK of retained earnings after the dividend deduction gives roughly 15.0-15.2%, which is under the target headroom. No subordinated issuance was announced in Q3, and management said it was evaluating ways to strengthen the capital structure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved precedent on this name. In September 2024 a SEK 100m Tier 2 issue and redemption landed inside a +9.8% results day.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 ratio is not public, and the September SEK move that inflates REA came after every Q2-era model. Asking what the money buys: it funds the German card growth that drives the stock, so a Tier 2 or AT1 issue would be read as neutral to mildly positive. Only a slower-growth or lower-payout message, or CET1 dilution, is negative. That is why this is sized small with a wide downside tail.
findings.independence: The Q2 CEO letter says 'we are evaluating opportunities to strengthen our capital structure' and that a weaker krona 'slightly affected the capital ratios' (same document). The FX direction is confirmed by https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/EURSEK=X?range=6mo&interval=1d. No independent analyst source.

baseline_tension: The findings lean modestly up, against a -6.1% 20-day run-up. The priced lean (+0.31) is just the run-up term with no short anchor, so nothing in the positioning contradicts or confirms them.
language_note: The filings are bilingual and identical (Swedish and English monthly statistics, reports and invitations), so they added nothing.

The Swedish wire copy (Finwire on placera.se) was the only source for the bar, the SB1 note (EPS 3.27, target price 235, 'i linje med konsensus') and the Q1/Q2 consensus tables, including the loan-book consensus that shows the under-call. No English source carried these.
lessons_applied: 'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': the loan-book finding cut from +1.0 to +0.6, because July and August are public and only the September increment is new.
'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 5.0 to 6.0, because the P&L is new and only the loan book is partly pre-released.
'Financing is a question': the capital-buffer finding cut from -0.8 to -0.5, because new subordinated capital would fund the German card growth the stock is valued on.
